boundaries: NUN is a specification-only repository; no bootable kernel, boot path, linker script, driver or scheduler is implemented.
The kernel must remain independently buildable once implementation exists; optional integrations must not become mandatory runtime dependencies.
Hardware, privilege transitions, memory mappings and interrupt behavior require architecture-specific implementation and evidence.
No automatic firmware or kernel installation is authorized by an update notification.

verification.host_tests: Not implemented; specification and manifest validation only.
verification.target_validation: Not implemented; no bootable image or supported target is declared.
